description:
Port test/suite/agent-session-model-extension.test.ts (~12 test cases) + 2835-tools-allowlist-filters-extension-tools.test.ts (~4 cases). Exercises:
- Tool execution blocking via tool_call event → {block, reason}
- Tool result modification via tool_result event
- Message context rewriting before LLM call (context event)
- Input transformation and handling in live session
- before_agent_start injection (custom messages, system prompt modification)
- Session lifecycle events (startup, reload, shutdown)
- Model selection tracking
- Dynamic tool registration on session_start
- Tool allowlist filtering for both built-in and extension tools

Requires the test harness (ticket 1). This is the heaviest integration test — expect the most issues here.
title: Port agent-session integration tests (tool blocking, result modification, context rewriting)
